Weekly GitHub Backup

Weekly backup of projects and skills to GitHub.
SKILL · RUNS AUTOMATICALLY WHEN IT APPLIES

What it does

Automatically backs up all Claude projects and skills to GitHub every Sunday at 7:00 AM. Runs on a schedule - no manual trigger needed.

When to use it

Runs automatically on its weekly schedule; no action required from you.

How to trigger it

(Runs automatically every Sunday at 7:00 AM - no manual trigger)

Requirements

What this skill needs in order to run. Added 2026-08-20.

Skills - None.

Connectors / MCP servers - None.

Folder access - Read access to the workspace being backed up.

KB modules / context files - None.

Repos - The backup repository. Write access required. It pushes a disposable mirror branch and must never target main - a version that pushed to main has diverged or wiped it before.

If something is missing - A credential or network failure is LOUD. The SILENT and most damaging case is a push to the wrong branch: a run that targets main instead of the mirror branch completes successfully and damages the repository, which is why the branch target is a hard rule rather than a default.
